title: Inventory Rights Before Programmatic Advertising Revenue
thesis: An advertising SDK cannot give BECK authority to sell screen time that it does not control.
body: An initial operator pilot requires explicit inventory rights, real screen location and playback evidence, permitted creatives, a qualified demand connection, payout and margin rules, and a safe cancellation route. Third-party MCP documentation enables a read-only integration assessment, not proven BECK-owned inventory or buyer commitments.
